name: northwind-hinglish-credential-phish
description: Invented Hinglish credential-phishing lure with urgency and an account threat. Asserts the hinglish language pack fires content.credential_verification (and typically urgency/account_threat). No personal data; Northwind house names only.

email.subject: Action zaroori: aapka account aaj block ho jayega
email.bodyText:
Priya customer,

Humne aapke account par suspicious activity detect ki hai. Aapko apna kyc turant update karna hoga warna account 2 ghante mein block ho jayega.

Apni pehchan verify karne aur block se bachne ke liye abhi login karein. Account verify karne ke liye link par click karein.

Dhanyavaad,
Northwind Security
